title: Users

lock.self: You cannot demote, disable or delete yourself. Ask another admin.
lock.lastPlatformAdmin: The last enabled platform admin cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted.
lock.platformTarget: Only platform admins can change platform admins.

usernameRule: 3 to 64 characters. Cannot be changed later.
passwordResetHint: Leave empty to keep the password. A new password signs the user out everywhere.
deleteText: The user loses access to this tenant. This cannot be undone.

error.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
error.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Check the list and try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
